title: FinanceMath external equation candidate review registry
purpose: Offline human-adjudication queue only; not a calibration manifest or approved cohort.

source.access_note: Source data files were read from the public GitHub repository at the pinned revision. Hugging Face dataset access requires accepting its contact-information conditions; this registry does not use that gated access path.

screening.method: Deterministic metadata/code-shape heuristic: Python solution present; arithmetic operator present; exclude obvious loop/import/library tokens; split table-dependent vs text-only by presence of tables.
screening.limitation: This is a broad candidate screen, not semantic equation extraction, formula correctness review, or mathematical-family deduplication. A solution may still depend on domain facts, table values, accounting rules, or multiple distinct subformulas. Every record requires independent human review.

usage_constraints: Do not count candidate records as independent equation families.
Do not assign calibration/evaluation cohorts until canonical family identity and overlap with Core-15 and historical 74 cases are adjudicated.
Validation and test are benchmark splits, not automatically calibration/evaluation cohorts; avoid using test labels to tune tau.
Preserve the original split and source IDs; do not copy question text or solution code into this derived registry.
A reviewer must document family-level deduplication, mathematical correctness, domain/category, and exclusion decisions.
